title: Frump's Unusual Relics

html:
Quest Giver: Tilles the Sellout

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 2 of Frump's Unusual Bowling League Trophy Relics from within Frump's Misfortune and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Quest Reward: 10 King's Coins

Return to: Tilles the Sellout

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Frump's Misfortune (quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect 2 of Frump's Unusual Bowling League Trophy Relics from within Frump's Misfortune and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Offer:

Relic Exchange of Townston: Specializing in Vendor Trash since Version 0.59!
WANTED: 2 of Frump's Unusual Bowling League Trophy Relics. Willing to pay King's Coin for Relics at a great rate! Contact Tilles the Sellout for more info.

Turn-in:

You have a knack for finding these Relics. I'll contact the person who posted the ad on your behalf.

Objectives:

  • Frump's Unusual Relics ×2

Client level range: 25–50
